name: Math Toolkit
tagline: The math that programming, data and science lean on.
description: Algebra, logic, probability and statistics, linear algebra and calculus, taught with interactive plots and simulations.
outcome: You can manipulate expressions, reason with logic and probability, and read the math in technical material.

stages.title: Core
stages.milestone: Solve and graph equations, and prove simple statements.

stages.title: Uncertainty and data
stages.milestone: Compute probabilities and read a distribution.

stages.title: Vectors and change
stages.milestone: Work with vectors and matrices and find derivatives.
